display.purpose: Page titles inside hero banners only. Student name on profile hero, Dashboard heading. Never below 36px / text-4xl.

headline.purpose: Top-level section headers. Used once per screen at the zone level.

title.purpose: Card headings, widget titles, metric values. Most frequent heading weight in the system.

body.purpose: Table rows, card descriptions, form values. 14px minimum; 65–75ch max line length.

label.purpose: Badge text, chip labels, form helper text, timestamps. DM Sans for machine-readability over warmth.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Card rest state. The base layer.

shadows.name: shadow-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card hover. Applied via Framer Motion whileHover at 150ms ease-out.

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: Sticky elements, sidebar when overlaying on mobile.

shadows.name: shadow-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring for interactive elements. Uses semantic focus token.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (colour, border, opacity).

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Page-entry stagger fade-up. Elements enter already moving fast and decelerate to rest.

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Elements leaving the screen accelerate out.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: Button press scale (0.98). Applied at 0ms so the press is instant.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.description: Max-width for the single-column layout. Sidebar becomes a bottom sheet.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.description: 2-column layout. Masonry drops from 3 to 2 columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The portal's single CTA. Pill shape, royal blue fill. Never more than one per visual section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; background-color: var(--brand); color: var(--text-inverse); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--brand-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background-color: var(--brand-active); transform: scale(0.98); transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action adjacent to a primary button. Never the lead CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; background-color: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: var(--surface-sunken); color: var(--text); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The ELITE Student Portal is an Operate-mode product: every student's job is to check in, track progress, submit work, and stay placement-ready. The design earns trust the same way a well-made engineering notebook does — through precision, clear hierarchy, and zero visual noise.

The portal separates itself from the category default — a grid of identical widgets on a neutral dashboard — through deliberate hierarchy. One large featured block dominates the top of each page; smaller, varied-height blocks orbit it; a single accent-coloured block draws the eye to the most time-sensitive action. Below that, masonry columns hold repeating cards of staggered heights so a student reads a page the way they read a well-laid out magazine spread.

Density is medium. Light mode is the primary scene (daylit labs and classrooms); dark mode is a toggle, not an afterthought.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetrical hero zone: one large featured block (7–8 of 12 columns) beside smaller supporting blocks, one always accent-tinted.
Masonry content zone: 3-column desktop, 2-column tablet, 1-column mobile, staggered card heights.
Royal blue (#2563EB) is the sole interactive accent — reserved, not scattered.
ELITE red (#E11D48) is for destructive actions and critical alerts only.
Every screen declares four states explicitly: loading skeleton, empty, error, and populated.
Motion is one authored entrance per section — stagger fade-up — plus a hover lift on interactive cards. No looping animations.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Royal blue #2563EB appears on ≤10% of any given screen's surface area. Its scarcity earns its authority.

rules.name: The Red Reservation Rule
rules.body: #E11D48 (ELITE red) does not appear on interactive brand elements. It is reserved for destructive actions and critical alerts only.

rules.name: The Display Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display is used only at text-3xl (30px) and above. A heading below 30px in Playfair reads decorative, not authoritative.

rules.name: The Pill Button Rule
rules.body: All interactive buttons use rounded-full (9999px). This single decision distinguishes interactive affordances from informational containers.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only in response to state: hover, elevation change, and fixed-position chrome.

rules.name: The No-Horizontal-Scroll Rule
rules.body: No page or component causes horizontal overflow at any of the three breakpoints. Tables scroll inside their own container, never the page.

dos: Do use text-brand (#2563EB) for all interactive accents — links, focus rings, active nav, primary buttons.
Do place the most time-sensitive information in the accent block (brand-soft tint) in the hero zone.
Do use rounded-full on every button.
Do give every data view all four states: loading skeleton, error state, empty state, populated content.
Do gate all Framer Motion animations behind useReducedMotion().
Do use tabular-nums on numeric values in metric tiles, tables, and stat blocks.
Do use the status-* semantic tokens for badge colours.
Do set aria-hidden=true on every Lucide icon.
Do size touch targets to a minimum of 44px on mobile.
Do scroll wide tables inside their own overflow-x: auto wrapper.
donts: Don't use #E11D48 (ELITE red) as the interactive brand accent on student-facing screens.
Don't build equal-height card grids in the masonry zone — staggered heights are the design.
Don't scatter brand blue as decoration on static elements.
Don't use raw Tailwind palette classes (bg-blue-600, text-slate-400) in components — use semantic tokens.
Don't write dark: variant classes on component elements — the token system handles theme switching.
Don't use Playfair Display below text-3xl (30px).
Don't use alert(), confirm(), or console.error() as user feedback.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs in place of icons.
Don't create a second button, card, or colour ramp — fix the existing one in place.
Don't animate on loop — one entrance per section on mount.
